specific_objectives: 3.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate various armaments carried by naval aircrafts

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of weapon diagrams and classification; Safety: Do not handle live ordnance; Instructor supervision: Monitor trainee engagement and clarify definitions.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of naval aircraft armaments?
Can you list three types of weapons carried by naval aircraft?
Why is it important to classify weapons by their delivery method?

development.content:
High Explosive Bomb Definition
Missile Propulsion Systems
Rocket Warhead Types
Torpedo Guidance Mechanisms
Depth Charge Deployment

Aircraft Gun Caliber Variations
Missile vs Rocket Distinction
Torpedo vs Depth Charge Usage
Bomb Fuzing Mechanisms
Weapon Integration on Aircraft

Summary of Weapon Characteristics
Operational Roles of Armaments
Safety Protocols for Armaments
Maintenance Requirements
Future Trends in Naval Weapons

summary_questions: Differentiate between a missile and a rocket based on guidance.
Explain the primary operational difference between a torpedo and a depth charge.
Identify two key safety precautions when handling aircraft armaments.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the High Explosive bomb and the Rocket, highlighting their distinct delivery and detonation methods for the next lesson.
